story: Waffle waited 11 months after being found on the Ring Road shoulder. Today he supervises homework, naps on three different sofas, and has decided monsoon thunder is survivable.
A shy tortoiseshell who hid behind her litter box for weeks. Six months on she greets guests at the door and sleeps curled against Saad's neck every night.
Surrendered with an untreated ear infection, Munna the rabbit now free-roams a sunny F-11 flat and has a documented weakness for coriander.
A ten-year-old shepherd nobody expected to place. Raja found a retired hiker who wanted a slow companion, and the pair have logged 400 gentle kilometres on the Pindi Point trails.
